description: Fine action tags for Phase 2 transition annotation. Each tag has a parent coarse action. Confidence: high/mid/low.
policy_description: Use tags from the list. If no tag fits, use other_<parent> with proposed_tag + description.

data.data_loading: Changed how data is loaded (read_csv, paths, file format)
data.data_cleaning: Data cleaning, filtering, deduplication, outlier removal
data.data_encoding: Type conversion, category encoding, dtype changes
data.missing_value_handling: Changed missing value strategy (fillna, impute, drop)
data.dataset_split: Changed train/test/holdout split (not CV — that's validation)
data.dataset_adapter: Adapted data for different format or API (e.g. Dataset class, DataLoader)
data.other_data: Doesn't fit above — provide proposed_tag + description

features.feature_selection: Applied feature selection method (importance, mutual info, SelectK)
features.lag_rolling: Added/changed lag, shift, or rolling window features
features.target_transform: Changed target variable transformation (log, rank, survival transform)
features.image_resize: Changed image input size or resize parameters
features.image_preprocessing: Changed domain-specific image preprocessing (crop, contrast, color space)
features.other_features: Doesn't fit above — provide proposed_tag + description

augmentation.other_augmentation: Doesn't fit above — provide proposed_tag + description

model.swap_backbone: Replaced model backbone entirely (e.g. ResNet→EfficientNet, LGBM→XGBoost)
model.add_head: Added or changed prediction head / output layer
model.checkpoint_swap: Switched to a different saved checkpoint or epoch (same model, different weights)
model.custom_module_change: Modified a custom nn.Module or model class definition
model.add_model_to_ensemble: Added a new model type (distinct from ensemble weight changes)
model.other_model: Doesn't fit above — provide proposed_tag + description

training._doc: Training config: optimizer, loss, scheduler, hparams
training.scheduler_change: Changed LR scheduler (cosine, step, plateau, warmup, etc.)
training.epoch_change: Changed number of epochs or training iterations
training.regularization_change: Changed regularization (dropout, weight decay, label smoothing)
training.class_weight_change: Changed class weights or sample weights for imbalanced data
training.gradient_config: Changed gradient clipping, accumulation, or mixed precision
training.other_training: Doesn't fit above — provide proposed_tag + description

ensemble.other_ensemble: Doesn't fit above — provide proposed_tag + description

validation.cv_scheme: Changed CV strategy (KFold, StratifiedKFold, GroupKFold, etc.)
validation.metric_change: Changed evaluation metric or added custom metric
validation.split_strategy: Changed train/val split logic (not the dataset split — that's data)
validation.other_validation: Doesn't fit above — provide proposed_tag + description

inference.submission_format: Changed submission file format or generation logic
inference.other_inference: Doesn't fit above — provide proposed_tag + description

infra.gpu_config: Changed GPU/device config (CUDA, mixed precision setup)
infra.run_config: Changed paths, seeds, random state, global config
infra.logging_wandb: Added/changed logging, W&B, or experiment tracking
infra.other_infra: Doesn't fit above — provide proposed_tag + description

housekeeping.error_fix: Fixed a bug or runtime error
housekeeping.syntax_fix: Fixed syntax error, typo, or import error
housekeeping.code_restructure: Refactored code structure (extract function, reorganize cells)
housekeeping.cosmetic: Cosmetic change (comments, print formatting, variable rename)
housekeeping.noop: Re-run with no meaningful code change
housekeeping.revert: Reverted to a previous version or undid a change
housekeeping.run_mode_toggle: Toggled train/inference mode by commenting/uncommenting blocks
housekeeping.other_housekeeping: Doesn't fit above — provide proposed_tag + description
